enabled.description: Enable the irqbalance daemon. When false, the service will not run.

banned_cpus.description: Hexadecimal CPU affinity mask for CPUs excluded from interrupt handling (e.g., 'f' excludes CPUs 0–3). Set to '0' to allow all CPUs.

pwr_thrst_threshold.description: Power threshold (percentage) above which aggressive power-saving balancing is triggered. 0 disables power-based balancing.

up_thresh.description: CPU usage threshold (percentage) above which performance-oriented balancing is triggered. Must be greater than pwr_thrst_threshold.

banlist.description: List of IRQ numbers to permanently exclude from balancing (e.g., ['1', '9', '120']).

ignore_irqs.description: List of IRQs to skip during periodic reassignment (e.g., legacy ISA IRQs).

rebalance_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between full rebalances of all IRQs, regardless of current distribution.

topology_mode.description: Topology unit to use for load balancing decisions: 'package' (sockets), 'core' (physical cores), or 'thread' (hyperthreads).

policies.description: Custom balancing policies. Each entry maps a policy class (currently only 'interrupts' is supported) to a balance level (e.g., 'balance', 'power', or 'performance').
